Ukraine's President Zelensky has expressed deep frustration with the US, saying it is not pushing Russia hard enough in talks to end Europe's bloodiest conflict since the Second World War. He told the BBC that he found it 'strange', to hear President Trump describe Russia's Vladimir Putin as his 'friend' during talks in China last week but President Trump says he told Putin he was his friend because he wants to get deal on Ukraine.
 
European Union leaders defer budget negotiations after tensions surfaced over the bloc's spending priorities and aid for Ukraine, while elsewhere the International Atomic Energy Agency has said it is working with both Russia and Ukraine to try to arrange a ninth localised ceasefire at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant . 乌克兰总统泽连斯基对美国表示了深切的失望，称美国在旨在结束欧洲自第二次世界大战以来最血腥冲突的谈判中，对俄罗斯施加的压力不够大。

他告诉英国广播公司，上周在中国的会谈中，听到特朗普总统称俄罗斯的弗拉基米尔·普京为“朋友”，他觉得“很奇怪”，但特朗普总统表示，他之所以对普京说他是他的朋友，是因为他想就乌克兰问题达成协议。

由于欧盟内部在支出重点和对乌克兰的援助问题上出现分歧，欧盟领导人推迟了预算谈判。与此同时，国际原子能机构表示，该机构正在与俄罗斯和乌克兰合作，以期在扎波罗热核电站安排第九次局部停火。

在此之前，还发生过另一次停电，显然也是由于军事活动所致。

articles.title: Marco Rubio v JD Vance: who will take over from Donald Trump? | BBC Americast
articles.titleZh: 马可·鲁比奥与J·D·万斯：谁将接替唐纳德·特朗普？| BBC Americast
articles.summary:
Donald Trump has two years left in the White House, but after a heavy midterms defeat, Republicans are already asking who will take over in 2028. How do the candidates distance themselves from him without risking revenge?

As the fallout continues from the Republican Party’s disastrous midterm results, attention has turned to who will replace Trump ahead of the 2028 presidential election and the all-important question of who will get his endorsement. 

With many Republicans angry at the White House and the policies that voters rejected this month, there are fears as to whether Trump’s actions in his last two years in office could cause more damage at the ballot box, with speculation growing that leading candidates could sit out the 2028 race and opt instead to run in 2032.

And despite initially signalling he may work with Democrats in Congress, Trump appears to have changed stance by appointing hardliner Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, pointing to the impending battle with Congress in January.

Plus, Justin and Sarah speak to Republican pollster Whit Ayres, who warned before the vote that MAGA voters alone couldn't win swing seats. What must the party do to win back the voters it has lost?

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
唐纳德·特朗普在白宫的任期还剩两年，但在中期选举惨败之后，共和党人已经在考虑谁将在2028年接任。

候选人如何与他划清界限，同时又不冒被报复的风险？

随着共和党中期选举惨败的影响持续发酵，人们的注意力已转向2028年总统大选前谁将接替特朗普，以及谁将获得他的背书这一至关重要的问题。

许多共和党人对白宫以及选民本月否决的政策感到愤怒，人们担心特朗普在任期最后两年的所作所为是否会在投票箱中造成更多损害，同时，越来越多的猜测认为，主要候选人可能会放弃2028年的竞选，而是选择在2032年参选。

尽管特朗普最初暗示他可能会与国会的民主党人合作，但他似乎已经改变了立场，任命强硬派斯蒂芬·米勒为新任幕僚长，这预示着他将在1月份与国会展开激烈斗争。

此外，Justin和Sarah采访了共和党民意调查专家Whit Ayres，后者在投票前曾警告称，仅靠MAGA选民无法赢得摇摆选区的席位。

该党必须做什么才能赢得失去的选民？

articles.title: How Trump's war with Iran and the Houthi conflict could change Saudi Arabia | Global News Podcast
articles.titleZh: 特朗普与伊朗的战争以及胡塞冲突如何改变沙特阿拉伯 | 全球新闻播客
articles.summary:
The Houthis have been stepping up their attacks on Saudi Arabia, as part of the ongoing fallout from the US-Israel war with Iran. The Tehran-backed group has launched drone and missile strikes deeper into Saudi Arabia, targeting oil refineries, and financial centres - including the headquarters of the Saudis' near-trillion dollar sovereign wealth fund. Last month an attack on Riyadh's international airport killed 13 people and injured more than 300. 

Our correspondent Nawal Al-Maghafi has been to the Saudi capital to see how people are dealing with the strikes. We hear how the conflict has changed the country's desired image as an oasis of stability, security and and prosperity in the Middle East. And ask whether President Donald Trump's war with Iran has meant for the US-Saudi alliance. 

Plus, the United Nations has said 20 million people are now in need of humanitarian assistance in Yemen, as the Houthis battle a Saudi-led coalition of pro-government forces. Nawal tells us about the scale of suffering caused by the fighting. 

00:00 Introduction
01:29 Life in Saudi Arabia under threat of Houthi attack
05:04 Is Saudi security and prosperity at risk? 
06:49 Has the US-Israel war with Iran put Saudi Arabia at greater risk? 
09:08 Suffering in Yemen as Saudi-led coalition battles Houthis

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

The Global News Podcast brings you the best of the BBC’s news coverage and analysis from around the world.

articles.readingTextZh:
作为美以与伊朗持续战争的余波之一，胡塞武装一直在加紧对沙特阿拉伯的袭击。

这个得到德黑兰支持的组织已向沙特阿拉伯纵深地带发动无人机和导弹袭击，目标是炼油厂和金融中心，包括沙特近万亿美元的主权财富基金总部。

上个月，利雅得国际机场发生袭击事件，造成13人死亡，300多人受伤。

我们的记者Nawal Al-Maghafi前往沙特首都，了解人们如何应对空袭。

我们了解到，这场冲突改变了该国在中东地区作为稳定、安全和繁荣绿洲的理想形象。

并探讨唐纳德·特朗普总统与伊朗的战争对美沙联盟意味着什么。

此外，联合国表示，由于胡塞武装与沙特领导的亲政府部队联盟交战，也门目前有2000万人需要人道主义援助。

纳瓦尔向我们讲述了战斗所造成的苦难的规模。
